expected.subject: Card declined
expected.body: Got an email that my payment failed. Will my account be shut off? I'm travelling until next week.

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

Your account won't be shut off right away. Here's how it works:

- Kettle retries the charge automatically 3 days and again 7 days after the first failed attempt, and you'll get an email each time.
- Your account stays fully active for 14 days after the first failed attempt.
- If the payment still hasn't gone through after 14 days, the account becomes read-only. You can still view and download invoices but can't create new ones.

So if you're back next week, you should still be within the 14 days. To fix it, at any time:

1. Go to Settings > Billing > Payment method.
2. Add a new card.
3. Click "Retry payment".

Access is restored as soon as the payment succeeds.

Common causes are an expired card, insufficient funds, or your bank blocking an online transaction. Since you're travelling, it may be worth checking with your bank that it isn't blocking the charge. Kettle charges appear on statements as "KETTLE APP".

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

expected.subject: Account read only
expected.body: I can't create invoices any more, it says the account is read-only. I need to bill a client today!

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

Sorry for the hassle, especially when you need to bill a client today.

One reason an account becomes read-only is a card payment that hasn't gone through. If Kettle can't charge your card, it retries automatically after 3 days and again after 7 days, and an email is sent at each failed attempt. Check your inbox for those payment emails to confirm whether this is the cause. 14 days after the first failed payment attempt, the account switches to read-only. You can still view and download invoices, but you can't create new ones.

To fix it:
1. Go to Settings > Billing > Payment method.
2. Add a new card.
3. Click "Retry payment".

Access is restored as soon as the payment succeeds, so you can create your invoice straight after. Billing is controlled by the account owner, so if you're not the owner, ask them to do this.

Common causes of failed payments are an expired card, insufficient funds, or your bank blocking an online transaction. Kettle charges appear on statements as "KETTLE APP".

The other reason an account becomes read-only is a cancelled subscription. After cancelling, the account stays active until the end of the period you've paid for. It then stays read-only for 90 days before the data is deleted. During that time you can export everything at Settings > Data > Export. If your subscription was cancelled, let us know.

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

The Kettle support team

1. Check the client's email address on the invoice carefully for typos, and confirm the exact address with your client.

4. If you need the client to have it right away, open the invoice, click "Copy link", and share the link directly via WhatsApp or another channel.

When the email goes through, ask your client to add invoices@kettle.app to their contacts. That helps future invoices avoid their spam folder.

Hi there,

To add a "Pay now" button to your invoices with PayFast:

1. Go to Settings > Payments.
2. Connect your PayFast account.

Once connected, your invoices will show a "Pay now" button. A few things worth knowing:

- Card payments settle into your account according to PayFast's payout schedule, not Kettle's.
- Invoices are marked Paid automatically when PayFast confirms the payment, usually within minutes. If an invoice stays Unpaid after your client has paid, check the payment appears in your PayFast dashboard, then mark it paid manually from the invoice menu.

expected.subject: Recurring on Growth?
expected.body: There's no 'Make recurring' option under More. Why?

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

The 'Make recurring' option only appears on the Pro plan. Growth includes unlimited invoices and bank sync, but recurring invoices are a Pro feature.

To get recurring invoices:
1. Go to Settings > Billing > Change plan and choose Pro (R699/month, VAT included). Upgrades take effect immediately, and you'll be charged a pro-rated amount for the rest of the current month.
2. Open any invoice and click More > Make recurring.
3. Choose the frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly) and the start date.

Each new invoice is created at 06:00 SAST on its due date. If 'Auto-send' is on, it's emailed to your client automatically.
